description: Revert to the absolute best-performing configuration (8 layers, 128 head dim, 128 batch size, 0.06 Matrix LR) with 0% warmup, as the most recent runs consistently achieved ~0.9882-0.9883, approaching the record 0.9881, and the trend suggests this aggressive setting is the most reliable path to the optimum without the instability of higher LRs or the suboptimal convergence of lower LRs.
